title: Row ids
summary: Every row is keyed by a TypeID that every device agrees on.

requirements.text: Every table's key is a TypeID string, the table's prefix and a UUIDv7 (`meal_01jd4x8m2kf7r9q3vz5w6t0hyc`), never an auto-increment integer.
A table's prefix never changes once rows exist.
A row imported from an external system gets an id derived from the table and its external key, so two devices importing it agree on the id.
The TypeScript, Kotlin and Rust id encoders produce the same ids, pinned to the TypeID specification's examples.
